# Silicon UI registry

Components and foundation are installed from https://ui.teamofsilicons.com/r/{name}.json. The adjacent lock records exact downloaded registry hashes. Product imports point to `components/silicon-ui`. App-specific blocks and layout helpers retain their existing behavior. The prior Arc MIT notice remains in `vendor/uiarc/LICENSE` for retained derivative source.

App layout aliases for older numeric spacing and corner names live in `styles/tokens.css`; registry tokens remain the source of their values. Decorative UserMenu avatars are hidden from the accessibility tree.
